name: fmp_available_countries
description:
Country codes FMP uses to classify companies, from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/available-countries as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Use the values as the country filter of fmp_stock_screener.
Example: {}
